info.name: GMP VISION — Complete REST API Collection
info.description: Production API test suite for GMP VISION cleanroom and industrial contracting platform. Compliant with instructions.md v2.2 and GMP_VISION_PRD.md v2.0.

request.description: Unauthenticated lightweight probe returning 200 if the Node.js Express process is up.
Deep health check verifying active MongoDB connection readyState === 1.
Authenticates administrative credentials, issues 15-minute access JWT and sets 7-day HttpOnly refresh cookie.
Rotates refresh token and issues a fresh 15-minute access token.
Retrieves the session profile for the currently authenticated administrator.
Clears the database refresh token hash and invalidates the HttpOnly cookie.
Lists all administrative user accounts. Restricted strictly to superadmin.
Provisions a new administrator account with bcrypt 12-round salted hashing.
Updates an administrator's status or role. Superadmin cannot demote their own account.
Permanently removes an administrator account. Self-deletion is strictly forbidden.
Returns the 7 core turnkey engineering divisions sorted by number (1..7).
Returns full division profile with its associated equipment/product catalog.
